name: Taking Care Of Our Body
overview: Scripture teaches that our bodies are created in the image of God and are to be honored as a living sacrifice to Him, reflecting holiness and dedication (Genesis 1:27; Romans 12:1). This calls for wise stewardship of our physical strength and purity, as exemplified by the Proverbs 31 woman and Daniel’s resolve to avoid defilement (Proverbs 31:17; Daniel 1:8). While Jesus encourages trust in God’s provision beyond physical needs (Luke 12:22), believers are also reminded to fear the Lord and turn from evil in all aspects of life, including how we care for our bodies (Proverbs 3:7).
